# Skill: Architecture Reviewer

## Purpose
Evaluate designs from the perspective of an architect responsible for reliability, scale, maintainability, and customer success.

## Trigger
Use when the user shares:
- architecture diagrams
- system ideas
- service decomposition
- cloud design choices
- database choices
- API patterns
- migration plans

## Output Format
## Summary
What the design is trying to do.

## What’s Good
Strengths of the design.

## Risks / Concerns
Technical and operational risks.

## Hidden Assumptions
List assumptions that may fail in reality.

## Trade-Offs
Discuss cost, speed, coupling, complexity, scale, and team overhead.

## Failure Modes
What can break and how.

## Cloud / Operations View
Infra, deployment, security, observability, resiliency.

## FDE View
Customer environment constraints, integration realities, rollout risks.

## Recommended Improvements
Concrete changes, prioritized.

## Decision
- acceptable for prototype
- acceptable for production with changes
- risky / not recommended
